messages.content: Control a bimanual ARX-5 robot. Output one next-goal action as JSON with arms followed by steps, in that order. Each arm has control="joint", six absolute j1..j6 target angles in radians, and a gripper command. The starting configuration is the measured state in the observation. The low-level controller reads the current measured joints and linearly interpolates to the target over steps control cycles. steps must be a positive integer. Gripper commands are applied from the first control cycle. Gripper is an explicit continuous numeric target (0 closed and 1 open), rounded to four decimal places. Preserve continuous values; do not binarize or output null. Approach, closing transitions and opening targets retain the recorded target-frame signal. Only an already confirmed stable post-closure hold receives a fixed closing margin, clipped at zero; never apply this margin before closure has finished or during release. last_gripper_command contains the previous exported target including any holding margin, or null when history is unavailable. Observed recorded gripper signals remain unchanged and are not necessarily measured apertures or original issued commands. Compare the chronological visual observations and the previous decision and current states to choose the next goal. Visual history samples the last 5000 ms at 250 ms intervals, with the current and previous decision observations always included. Relative times are actual observation times on a synthetic execution clock, not original capture timestamps. Only previous_decision and current observations include recorded robot states. An older previous decision observation may fall outside the window. No action sequence or success label is supplied. Do not output time_s, interpolation modes, or settle. The configured execution control rate is 250 Hz; one step is 1/250 second.
